task_description: Build a university student grade-tracking web application with React + Tailwind frontend (pastel pink/purple palette, dark/light mode), Node.js/Express backend with JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL database. Supports simple and composite subjects with configurable weight percentages for calculating weighted averages.

verification.summary: Full monorepo build succeeds (shared + backend + frontend). All 23 tests pass (18 backend grade calculator tests + 5 frontend render tests). FEAT-005 addresses review blocking issues: JWT validated at module load, serverless import path fixed, rate limiting on auth, period endpoint simplified.
